title: Large Language Models for Subjective Language Understanding: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying fairness audits from existing literature that reveal persistent age-related biases in LLM-based sentiment analysis deployments.
Reviewing studies on stance detection that measure political alignment (e.g., liberal skew) and the models' sensitivity to political and demographic cues.

Evaluating performance disparities and misinterpretations in subjective tasks (such as humor detection, metaphor recognition, and sentiment analysis) across different cultural groups, languages, and dialects.

Summarizing ethical evaluations and literature demonstrating how LLMs replicate systemic training data biases against sensitive demographic attributes in subjective language understanding and moderation.
